For DFC · 2026 Daily meal delivery in Dubai Festival City

By the Messify team · Updated October 2026 · 5 min read

Quick answer

Messify delivers daily meal plans in Dubai Festival City (DFC), to homes in Al Badia and offices across DFC. All of the day's meals arrive together every morning in one chilled bag, from AED 25 a meal (AED 215 for a 1-meal weekly plan). Start in the Messify app or on WhatsApp.

Everyday meals in DFC, without the daily decision

Dubai Festival City has no shortage of places to eat. The harder part is the everyday: deciding what to have three times a day, paying delivery and service fees on every order, and waiting on riders when everyone in Al Badia or the office towers orders at the same time. A daily meal plan takes that decision off your plate. You choose your meals ahead in an app, and they arrive every morning.

Messify now delivers meal plans in Dubai Festival City (DFC), alongside Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis and International City. This guide explains how it works, what it costs and who it suits.

How daily meal delivery works in Dubai Festival City

  1. Pick a plan in the Messify app: 1, 2 or 3 meals a day, weekly or monthly.
  2. Choose tomorrow's meals by 6 PM. The menu changes every day, and you see it in the app the day before.
  3. Get your bag every morning. All of the day's meals arrive together in one chilled bag with an ice pack, at your home or your office in DFC.
  4. Reheat and eat. Meals are blast-chilled after cooking. Keep them cold, then reheat for a few minutes when you're ready.

Every meal is cooked fresh daily in our partner kitchen in International City and is 100% halal, with a vegetarian option every day, for every meal.

What a meal plan costs in DFC

Prices are the same in Dubai Festival City as in every Messify area, from AED 25 a meal:

  • Weekly: AED 215, 415 or 610 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day (7 days of meals to use within 9 days).
  • Monthly: AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day (26 days of meals to use within 30 days).

The 2-meal monthly plan, lunch and dinner sorted, works out to AED 26.92 a meal. To compare with what you spend on delivery apps now, try our meal plan vs ordering in calculator, or see every option on our meal plans in Dubai page.

For people living in Al Badia and around DFC

If you live in Al Badia Residences, Al Badia Hillside Village or elsewhere in Dubai Festival City, a 2 or 3-meal plan covers most of your day: breakfast before work, lunch to take with you, dinner ready when you get home. Because everything arrives together in the morning, there's no waiting in for a rider at 8 PM.

For people working in Dubai Festival City

Office lunch is where a meal plan helps most. Your meals are delivered to your office in the morning, so lunch is waiting before the 1 PM rush. Several colleagues interested? Teams can share one monthly plan with one morning delivery for everyone, while each person still chooses their own meals in the app. Planning a meeting lunch or company event instead? See our catering in Dubai.

Weekends, travel and nights out

Every meal on a Messify plan is a token. Skip a day in the app and use that meal on another day of your plan, or spend extra tokens to double up when a friend comes over. Monthly plans give you 30 days to use 26 days of meals, so a weekend away doesn't cost you anything.

How to start in DFC

Orders aren't taken on this website. There are two ways to start:

  • Download the Messify app, choose your plan and pay in the app.
  • Message us on WhatsApp with your building in Dubai Festival City, and a real person on our team will help you choose and get started.

Read more on our meal plans in Dubai Festival City page, or start your plan.

Questions people ask

Is there a meal plan that delivers in Dubai Festival City?

Yes. Messify delivers meal plans every morning across Dubai Festival City (DFC), including Al Badia. All of the day's meals arrive together in one chilled bag, from AED 25 a meal.

How much does a meal plan cost in DFC?

Weekly plans cost AED 215, 415 or 610 and monthly plans AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day. That is AED 25.63 to 30.71 per meal.

Can I get office lunch delivered in Dubai Festival City?

Yes. Meals arrive at your office every morning, so lunch is ready before the lunchtime rush. Teams can share one monthly plan with one delivery for everyone.

Is the food halal? Is there a vegetarian option?

Every Messify meal is 100% halal, and there is a vegetarian option every day, for every meal.

Can I order on the website?

No. Start in the Messify app, or message us on WhatsApp and our team will help you get started.
